en.ball.title: bgjobs: {total} job(s), {running} running — click to expand
en.btn.expand.title: Expand full panel
en.cleanup.menuTitle: Cleanup/delete: open the trash bar (drag finished jobs or bulk-clean)
en.collapse.btn.title: Collapse to a compact job list (hides header/filters/group paths; click a row to expand)
en.fold.grip.title: Click to expand
en.footer.label: Jobs
en.force.ask.cancel.title: Cancel: no request is sent and the records stay untouched
en.force.ask.confirm.title: Confirm = this request carries force (?force=1) — same rule as CLI -Force / the GUI confirm box
en.force.ask.hint: Continuing will remove their records (job dir + central index) and may leave an orphan process you can no longer see. Continue?
en.force.ask.many: The process probe/lookup failed for {count} jobs: it is impossible to tell whether they are still running or already gone.
en.force.ask.one: The process probe/lookup for job "{name}" ({id}) itself failed: it is impossible to tell whether it is still running or already gone.
en.force.ask.title: Cannot determine the process state
en.full.access.title: Pre-approve full-access background jobs. When on, wider-than-session permission requests no longer prompt each time; deployments without the dsh sandbox policy service must also enable this to submit.
en.job.trashHint: Drag to the trash below to delete
en.list.empty: No background jobs yet (an agent submits them via bgjob_submit)
en.list.empty.scope: No jobs under the current session workspace (turn off the filter to see all)
en.log.garbled: (⚠ This log was corrupted while being written: the job emitted GBK but it was recorded as UTF-8, so Chinese is unrecoverable. New pwsh-engine jobs are fixed.)
en.minimize.btn.title: Minimize to a floating ball (it appears where the button was)
en.notify.done.title: This job result was delivered into the session context (via notify completion or a bgjob_wait return)
en.notify.pending.title: This job result has not been delivered into the session context yet (notify not delivered, not returned by bgjob_wait); the agent can wait via bgjob_pending_list / bgjob_wait
en.only.session.title: Show only jobs under the active session workspace (incl. subdirectories)
en.panel.title: Background Jobs
en.row.expand.title: Click to expand full panel
en.sandbox.backends.title: Sandbox selection (experimental): when on, bgjob_submit_pwsh accepts sandbox_backend=dsh, reusing the session dsh sandbox provider (ctx.sandbox.confine) to wrap the job argv at submit time; when off that value is rejected with no side effects. Does not affect jobs already running.
en.settings.entryDesc: Show/hide the "Background Jobs" entry at the bottom of the DSH sidebar (click toggles the monitor panel).
en.settings.gui.openDesc: Launches the standalone manager window (no DSH needed); if it does not appear, double-click dsh-bgjobs-gui.bat at the path below.
en.settings.gui.openedHint: Launch requested. If no window appears in a few seconds, use "Reveal in folder" and double-click dsh-bgjobs-gui.bat.
en.settings.gui.openedReveal: Opened the offline tools folder in File Explorer.
en.settings.intro: Manage the bgjobs web entry and offline tools.
en.settings.panelDesc: Show/hide the floating monitor panel (incl. the ball) at the bottom-right; independent of the sidebar entry toggle.
en.settings.title: Background Jobs (bgjobs)
en.trash.all.title: Delete every finished job in the current view (incl. <24h)
en.trash.older.title: Delete only jobs finished over 24h ago (default keeps the last 24h)
